description: Get the stored declared cash dividends of an exact stock or ETF listing, newest first. Each row gives the ex-dividend date and cash amount per share in USD. Date filters apply to the ex-dividend date. Future ex-dates can appear after a dividend is declared. Each listing reports its own payments: a share class (BRK-A beside BRK-B) or a fund series sharing its trust's filer (SCHD beside FNDA) never inherits another listing's dividends.

endDate.description: Optional latest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 20, max: 500).

offset.description: Number of newest matching records to skip for pagination (default: 0).

startDate.description: Optional earliest ex-dividend date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

ticker.description: Listed stock or ETF ticker (e.g., AAPL, BRK-A, SCHD).

name: GetDividendHistory
title: Dividend History
